query: The project will establish a national computer emergency response team and a security operations centre to monitor and respond to cyber incidents.
Firewalls, intrusion detection and endpoint protection will be installed to secure the government network.
Data will be encrypted in transit and at rest, and a public key infrastructure will be deployed.
Multi-factor authentication and privileged access management will control access to the platform.
Independent penetration testing and vulnerability assessments will be carried out before the system goes live.
The agency will undergo a security audit and obtain ISO 27001 certification.
The project will support drafting of the national cybersecurity strategy and cybercrime law.
Government IT staff will be trained in cybersecurity and users will receive security awareness training.
The project will strengthen the cybersecurity of digital public systems against cyber attacks.
